You are building Step 6 of the Clientloop Phase 1 UI shell plan. Full plan at `/Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/zany-mixing-flame.md`. Project: `~/Clientloop`. Prior steps complete: scaffold, mock data, shell, dashboard, inbox (commit `2b94e89`). ## Context — read first 1. `~/Clientloop/lib/types.ts` — `Client`, `Service`, `Plan` 2. `~/Clientloop/lib/mock/clients.ts` — 12 clients with plan mix 3. `~/Clientloop/lib/mock/services.ts` — 6 productized services 4. `~/Clientloop/lib/utils/time.ts` — `formatRelative` helper (reuse) 5. `~/Clientloop/components/inbox/inbox-table.tsx` — **study this** as the reference pattern for: separate filter Card + separate overflow-hidden table Card, stopPropagation on actions, responsive column hiding, empty state wired inside Card 6. `~/Clientloop/components/inbox/filter-bar.tsx` — reference for Select + search pattern 7. `~/Clientloop/app/(dashboard)/clients/page.tsx` + `services/page.tsx` — placeholders, replace both 8. `/Users/yashbaldha/.claude/memory/design/patterns/data-tables.md` — table rules ## Scope — Step 6 Build two data-table pages: **Clients** and **Services**. Plus two non-functional `Dialog` stubs: "New Client" and "New Service". Reuse patterns from `inbox-table.tsx`. ### Component structure ``` components/clients/ clients-table.tsx (server OK, pure props) clients-filter-bar.tsx ("use client") new-client-dialog.tsx ("use client") components/services/ services-table.tsx services-filter-bar.tsx (simpler: search + category) new-service-dialog.tsx ``` ### 1. `components/clients/clients-table.tsx` ```tsx interface ClientsTableProps { clients: readonly Client[]; onClearFilters?: () => void; } ``` Card-wrapped table (`overflow-hidden` + `p-0`), columns: 1. Client — Avatar (from `avatarUrl`) + name + email underneath (two-line cell). `font-medium`, email `text-xs text-muted-foreground` 2. Company — plain text 3. Plan — small pill badge with tone: - free → slate - starter → sky - growth → violet (primary-tinted: `bg-primary/10 text-primary`) - scale → emerald Use a typed `Record` 4. Active Requests — `tabular-nums`, right-aligned on md+ (`text-right`) 5. MRR — `$X,XXX/mo` formatted (use `Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", { style: "currency", currency: "USD", maximumFractionDigits: 0 })`), `tabular-nums`, `text-right` 6. Joined — `formatRelative(joinedAt)` for consistency with inbox 7. Actions — 2 ghost icon buttons (`Pencil`, `Trash2`) with `stopPropagation`, always visible, `text-muted-foreground` Responsive: hide Company and Joined on md and below (`hidden md:table-cell`). Row: `cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/30`. Footer below table (inside Card but below TableBody): `
Showing {clients.length} of 12
` — but since filters can change this, render `{clients.length === 12 ? \`Showing all 12 clients\` : \`Showing \${clients.length} of 12\`}`. Empty state (`clients.length === 0`): EmptyState with Users icon, title "No matching clients", description "Try clearing your filters", action "Clear filters" → calls `onClearFilters`. ### 2. `components/clients/clients-filter-bar.tsx` `"use client"`. Own Card with `p-4`. Filters: - Search input with Search icon, placeholder "Search by name, company, or email…", `w-full sm:w-72` - Plan Select (options: all, free, starter, growth, scale) - "Clear filters" ghost button with X — only when active ```tsx interface ClientsFilters { search: string; plan: Plan | "all"; } interface FilterBarProps { filters: ClientsFilters; onChange: (f: ClientsFilters) => void; onClear: () => void; hasActiveFilters: boolean; } ``` Follow the inbox FilterBar pattern exactly — same base-ui Select null-guard (`val ?? "all"`). ### 3. `components/clients/new-client-dialog.tsx` `"use client"`. Non-functional shadcn Dialog. ```tsx interface NewClientDialogProps { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void; } ``` Fields (all plain controlled state, NO react-hook-form — Riko noted it wasn't installed): - Contact Name (Input) - Email (Input type="email") - Company (Input) - Plan (shadcn Select — free/starter/growth/scale, default "starter") - MRR (Input type="number", placeholder "149") Footer: Cancel (outline) + "Create client" (primary). On create: ```ts import { toast } from "sonner"; toast.success("Client created (demo)", { description: "Connect Supabase to persist data." }); onOpenChange(false); ``` Reset form state on open change to false. Dialog structure: `DialogContent` (max-w-md), `DialogHeader` > `DialogTitle` "New client" + `DialogDescription` "Add a client to your workspace.", body with fields in `space-y-4`, `DialogFooter`. ### 4. `app/(dashboard)/clients/page.tsx` `"use client"`. Filtering and dialog state. ```tsx "use client"; import { useMemo, useState } from "react"; import { clients as allClients } from "@/lib/mock"; import { PageHeader } from "@/components/common/page-header"; import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"; import { Plus } from "lucide-react"; import { ClientsTable } from "@/components/clients/clients-table"; import { ClientsFilterBar } from "@/components/clients/clients-filter-bar"; import { NewClientDialog } from "@/components/clients/new-client-dialog"; import type { Plan } from "@/lib/types"; interface ClientsFilters { search: string; plan: Plan | "all"; } const initial: ClientsFilters = { search: "", plan: "all" }; export default function ClientsPage() { const [filters, setFilters] = useState(initial); const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false); const filtered = useMemo(() => allClients.filter(c => { if (filters.plan !== "all" && c.plan !== filters.plan) return false; if (filters.search) { const q = filters.search.toLowerCase(); if (!c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) && !c.company.toLowerCase().includes(q) && !c.email.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return false; } return true; }), [filters]); const hasActive = filters.search !== "" || filters.plan !== "all"; return ( <> setDialogOpen(true)}>New client} />
setFilters(initial)} hasActiveFilters={hasActive} /> setFilters(initial)} />
); } ``` ### 5. `components/services/services-table.tsx` Same pattern as clients-table. Columns: 1. Name — font-medium + category subtitle muted ("Design", "Content", etc.) 2. Description — `text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2 max-w-md` 3. Flat Price — `$X flat/mo`, `tabular-nums`, `text-right`. **Emphasize flat pricing wedge**: pill wrapper with subtle `bg-primary/5 text-primary` and "flat" label. Actually simpler: plain `$299 / mo` in `font-semibold tabular-nums` + tiny badge "FLAT" next to it (primary tinted, 10px uppercase). 4. Turnaround — "3 days", muted 5. Active Clients — number, tabular, right-aligned 6. Actions — Pencil, Trash2 stop-propagation Category map typed `Record`: - design → violet - development → blue - seo → emerald - content → amber - video → rose - ads → orange Render the category chip in col 1 below the name (`text-xs` pill). Responsive: hide Description on md and below. Row clickable + hover (even though no destination). Empty state on filter. ### 6. `components/services/services-filter-bar.tsx` Simpler. Just search + category Select. ```tsx interface ServicesFilters { search: string; category: Service["category"] | "all"; } ``` ### 7. `components/services/new-service-dialog.tsx` Same pattern as new-client-dialog. Fields: - Name (Input) - Description (Textarea — shadcn) - Category (Select) - Flat Price (Input type="number") - Turnaround Days (Input type="number") Toast "Service created (demo)". ### 8. `app/(dashboard)/services/page.tsx` Mirror clients page structure but for services. ### 9. Verification ``` cd ~/Clientloop pnpm tsc --noEmit pnpm lint pnpm build pnpm dev & sleep 3 curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:3000/clients curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:3000/services kill %1 2>/dev/null ``` All must pass. Both routes must return 200. ### 10. Commit ``` git add -A && git commit -m "feat(clients,services): data tables with filters and non-functional create dialogs" ``` ## Hard rules - NO `any`, NO `@ts-ignore`, NO `as X` except `as const` - NO react-hook-form — plain `useState` for form fields - Reuse existing shadcn primitives (Dialog, Select, Input, Textarea, Button, Badge) - If Textarea not yet installed, run: `cd ~/Clientloop && pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add textarea` - Respect `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` - Dialogs use controlled `open` / `onOpenChange` props from parent - No business logic — Save just toasts and closes ## Report back (under 300 words) - Files created - tsc/lint/build results - curl results for /clients and /services - Commit hash - Any deviations

1	# Clientloop — Phase 1 UI Shell Plan
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	Clientloop is the codename (from Phase 18 dossier candidates) for the ManyRequests-style SaaS already researched across 22 phases in the Boldteq dossier (`ManyRequestsDossier.jsx`). The dossier returned a **conditional GO** with a hard gate at Phase 15: 300 waitlist + 10 paid LOIs before writing code.
6	
7	Yash is **intentionally overriding** the gate for a narrow purpose: build the **UI shell only** (mock data, no backend, no auth wiring) so it can be **used as the clickable validation asset** Phase 15 already requires (Figma-alternative prototype for LOI interviews). This is the cheapest path to satisfy the gate without wasting build effort later — the shell becomes real production code once the gate passes.
8	
9	**What we are building in Phase 1:**
10	- Agency-side UI shell for Clientloop
11	- Next.js 15 App Router + TypeScript (strict, no `any`) + Tailwind + shadcn/ui
12	- Three working screens: Dashboard Home, Request Inbox (table + Kanban toggle), Clients/Services/Settings
13	- All data mocked in `lib/mock/` — zero backend, zero auth, zero DB
14	- Fully responsive, dark-mode capable, production-quality look
15	- Deployable to Vercel as a static demo on day 1
16	
17	**What we are NOT building:**
18	- No Clerk, Neon, Prisma, Razorpay, Stripe, Claude API, tRPC
19	- No Request Detail + AI Brief screen (deferred — dossier's hero feature, but not in this pass per user selection)
20	- No client-facing portal (agency side only)
21	- No landing page / marketing site (separate Quill work later)
22	
23	**Why it matters:** the dossier's wedge is AI request-to-brief + flat pricing + Razorpay. The UI shell must *look* like a product that ships those things, even though none are wired. Visuals sell the LOIs.
24	
25	---
26	
27	## Name & Branding
28	
29	- **Product name (Phase 1):** Clientloop
30	- **Rationale:** shortest, most pronounceable of the 10 candidates, and the word "loop" ties directly to Phase 21's client-invite viral loop (the actual growth engine)
31	- **Trademark risk:** NOT cleared — dossier flags CHECK gate. Treat name as provisional. Use it in UI, but do not register domains or trademarks yet
32	- **Wordmark:** plain text `Clientloop` in Inter bold for v1, no logo commissioned yet
33	- **Primary color:** Violet (`#6d28d9`) — already used in the dossier artifact header, carries forward as brand accent
34	
35	---
36	
37	## Architecture Decision: Scaffold Fresh
38	
39	Confirmed via Explore agent: no existing Next.js projects in Yash's active portfolio. Rankora and CROBOT are both Vite+React+React Router (Lovable-origin) — not migratable to Next.js 15 App Router. shadcn components and Tailwind tokens are portable; everything else is a rewrite.
40	
41	**Decision:** `pnpm create next-app@latest Clientloop` at `~/Clientloop`. Copy token structure from Rankora's Tailwind config but nothing else.
42	
43	**Memory impact:** create `~/.claude/memory/stacks/saas-nextjs-15.md` after scaffold so the next Next.js SaaS inherits these patterns. (Mira runs this after Phase 1 completes.)
44	
45	---
46	
47	## Directory Layout

117	---
118	
119	## Implementation Steps
120	
121	### Step 1 — Scaffold & Tokens (Riko)

124	2. `cd Clientloop && pnpm dlx shadcn@latest init` → New York style, neutral base, CSS variables, `--radius: 0.75rem`

128	   - Extend `boxShadow` with `soft` and `card` tokens (from `ui-redesign-shadcn.md` patterns)

234	**Done when:** all 4 subpages render, tab switching navigates, underline active state visible.

236	### Step 8 — Visual Review & Polish (Vega)
237	Agent: **Vega** (Design review)
238	1. Run design review against `~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/ui-redesign-shadcn.md` checklist
239	2. Verify: radius 0.75rem applied, Inter loaded, shadows `soft`/`card` applied to cards, typography scale correct on all pages, KPI animation staggered, no hardcoded colors

241	4. Mobile check at 375px: sidebar drawer, Kanban single-column, tables horizontally scrollable
242	5. Return a punch list of visual fixes → Koda applies
243
